summary: Iteration 213 - Taxi Destination Search Bug Fix Verification. Bug fix CONFIRMED WORKING. When typing 'Pri' (3 letters), the search now shows relevant Kosovo places (Prishtina, Prizren, Flughafen Prishtina) at the top of suggestions. When typing 'Prishtina', it shows Prishtina city and Flughafen Prishtina (airport). Search results are clickable and lead to vehicle selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 213 verified the taxi destination search bug fix. Key findings: (1) taxiSearchPresets.js contains PRESET_PLACES with Kosovo cities (Prishtina, Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Ferizaj) and Flughafen Prishtina airport, (2) getTaxiPresetPlaceHints() returns preset matches when query length >= 3 characters, (3) Aliases like 'pri', 'pris', 'prist', 'pristina', 'prishtina' all match Prishtina, (4) TaxiPage.jsx combines preset hints with live geocoder results via dedupeTaxiPlaces(), (5) Regional hints section shows 'NAHE TREFFER' with prioritized Kosovo places, (6) Search results section shows 'ALLE TREFFER' with combined results, (7) Mobile layout works correctly on 390x844 viewport.
